work.title: Untitled (Planes, Targets, Discs)
work.description: Large-format collage on white ground combining warplane diagrams, compact discs, bullseye targets, and a chess piece across layered paper sections of yellow, black, and magenta. Perforated-dot grids, concentric rings, and partial text fragments including "HOW TO CREA" are distributed across the picture plane.
work.composition: scattered layered fragments across white ground
keywords: HOW TO CREATE text fragment collage
